independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the viewport, the toast container and its action and close.
The framework-free toast store both renderers draw: add, update, close, promise, timers and their pause.

intent: Tell the user briefly that something happened or is in progress, without interrupting their task, with an optional action

properties.description: How many toasts are shown; older ones stay mounted, data-limited and inert, until the newer ones close.
Auto-dismiss delay in ms for toasts added without a timeout (the manager's default; 0 keeps them). Hover, focus and a hidden document pause it.
The window corner or edge the stack sits at, in the top layer; inline draws the toasts in flow, 2u apart (specimens and previews).
Space-separated directions a swipe dismisses toward: up, down, left, right (default down right).
Accessible name of the region landmark (aria-label).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: openchange
events.detail: { open: boolean, id: string, toast: ToastObject, reason: 'swipe' | 'close-press' | 'escape-key' | 'none', event?: Event }
events.trigger: a toast is added (open true, reason none) or closes: a swipe, the close or Escape on a focused toast (cancelable: preventDefault keeps it), or its timeout or a script close (reason none, after the fact)

semantics.role: region (a polite live region, aria-relevant additions text); each toast role=dialog (alertdialog and aria-live assertive for priority high), aria-modal false, named by its title and described by its description

keyboard.action: move focus into the viewport when it has toasts (a placed one, not inline); F6 again returns it to where it was
move between the toasts' actions and close buttons

keyboard.keys: Enter, Space on the action or close
keyboard.action: press it (the close dismisses the toast)

sources: label (aria-label on the region; default Notifications)

content.children: None authored: the viewport draws a [data-part=toast] per toast of its manager, newest first, each with a content part of title, description, action (from actionProps) and close parts.

constraints: Toasts are added through a toast manager (the page's toastManager, or the viewport's manager property), not as markup; every viewport bound to a manager draws its toasts.
Title and description are text in the web component; the React parts take any node.
The action runs actionProps.onClick and does not close the toast; the application closes it when the action needs to.
The stack variables (--toast-index, --toast-offset-y, --toast-height, --toast-frontmost-height, --toast-swipe-movement-x / -y) are px set by script from layout.
Do not put the only copy of important information in a toast: it disappears after its timeout.

avoidWhen.when: The user must read and decide before going on.
avoidWhen.reason: A toast does not take focus or block the page and leaves after its timeout; a modal dialog is needed (the kit has none yet).

avoidWhen.when: A validation error on a field.
avoidWhen.reason: The error belongs next to the control; the field's error part shows it there.

nodes.summary: Base UI Toast.Positioner: an anchored toast's box (positionerProps.anchor), fixed in the top layer and placed by script beside the anchor (side default top, align center, 1u or sideOffset away; data-side).

One toast (Base UI Toast.Root; data-part toast because the viewport is the recipe root): role=dialog or alertdialog, a card-sm container; data-type, data-expanded, data-limited, data-swiping, data-swipe-direction, data-starting-style, data-ending-style.
Base UI Toast.Arrow: an anchored toast's arrow pointing at the anchor, as a popover's (2u wide, spanning the 1u gap).
The toast's parts in a grid (Base UI Toast.Content); data-behind (hidden while collapsed) when another toast is in front.
The heading (Base UI Toast.Title), the title type role; names the toast.
The message (Base UI Toast.Description), the body-sm role, 0.5u under the title; describes the toast.
The toast's action (Base UI Toast.Action; role=button, a native button in React) from actionProps: an 8u control row on the control fill.
Closes its toast (Base UI Toast.Close; role=button named Close, a native button in React): a 6u slot with an x at icon size sm.
